listing.name: Demon's Souls — DemonsSouls native port (troler11) (troler11)
listing.summary: The project reports a playable tutorial and saving, with only short tests beyond the tutorial. A full playthrough is unconfirmed; particle and sky defects remain. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA BLUS30443 version 1.00 PS3_GAME folder and firmware/dev_flash prepared through your own RPCS3 setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the source setup, code-translation and build instructions with your own disc and firmware files.

warnings: The project reports a playable tutorial and saving, with only short tests beyond the tutorial. A full playthrough is unconfirmed; particle and sky defects remain.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
